dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How have things gone for you, recently?

dialogues.speaker: Iara
dialogues.text: Yup. After learning what you taught me and scattering lots of bait, I learned how to attract fish.

dialogues.speaker: Iara
dialogues.text: But catching them can still be pretty tough. Haven't caught too many, but the fish in the surrounding waters sure did get plumper — that's something, I guess?
